events.factual_description: National Sawdust presents John Carroll Kirby on Saturday, October 3, 2026 at 7:30 PM, with doors at 6:30 PM, at 80 North 6th St in Brooklyn. Kirby's official tour page independently lists the National Sawdust date and identifies the performance as a solo set. National Sawdust describes Kirby as a pianist with a jazz-steeped background whose work bridges pop, soul and improvisation. The performance follows the August 28, 2026 release of Piano Works 2016-2026 on Stones Throw Records, a collection of impromptu piano pieces composed and recorded while traveling over the preceding decade. Stones Throw says the collection departs from the full-band sound of Kirby's recent records and documents the melodic and harmonic vocabulary informing his wider compositional work. The exact National Sawdust event page links to an authorized AudienceView Professional purchase destination. en.why_it_matters: The solo billing is the reason to care about this particular date. Kirby is usually heard as a pianist-producer whose jazz foundation dissolves into soul, pop, ambient color and groove; here the band architecture falls away and the keyboard language itself becomes the event. Coming just after Piano Works 2016-2026 exposed a decade of the melodic, harmonic and improvised vocabulary underneath his records, the National Sawdust set offers a focused way to hear that instrumental identity without the production camouflage. If New York is in play, actively make room for it.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play, build the Brooklyn evening around National Sawdust. From the DMV, I would pair it with another strong reason to be in the city rather than make a dedicated round trip solely for this solo set.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para fijarse en esta fecha es que viene anunciada como un set solista. A Kirby normalmente se le escucha como pianista-productor: una base de jazz que se disuelve entre soul, pop, ambiente y groove; aquí desaparece la arquitectura de banda y el lenguaje del teclado queda al centro. Justo después de que Piano Works 2016-2026 sacara a la luz una década del vocabulario melódico, armónico e improvisado que sostiene sus discos, National Sawdust ofrece una forma concentrada de escuchar esa identidad instrumental sin el camuflaje de la producción. Si Nueva York está en juego, sí le haría espacio activamente.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego, armaría la noche de Brooklyn alrededor de National Sawdust. Desde el DMV la combinaría con otra razón fuerte para estar en la ciudad en vez de hacer un viaje dedicado de ida y vuelta únicamente por este set solista.
